# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting T2 Code or W3 Dev LLC-operated infrastructure to
[security@ashutosh.pw](mailto:security@ashutosh.pw). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://t2.codes/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
